headline: US Captures Maduro, Trump To 'Run It'

beats.text: The US bombed Caracas overnight and captured Venezuela's president. Hours later, Trump had a bigger plan than an arrest.

beats.caption: successfully captured Maduro in the dead of night
beats.label: via USA TODAY

beats.text: Great heist-movie setup. Terrible way to run a foreign policy briefing.

beats.caption: It was dark. And it was deadly.
beats.label: via USA TODAY

beats.text: With Maduro in custody, Trump skipped right past the part where someone else takes over.

beats.caption: So we are going to run the country
beats.label: via USA TODAY

beats.text: Define transition. Take your time, sir — you've got nothing but a whole country and its oil now.

beats.caption: we can do a safe, proper, and judicious transition
beats.label: via USA TODAY

beats.text: He also repeated a Maduro-fentanyl claim PolitiFact rated false — most fentanyl entering the US comes through Mexico, not Venezuela.

beats.caption: flooded our nation with lethal poison
beats.label: via USA TODAY

beats.text: Recap: we bombed a capital, grabbed a president, and now own the oil business. Cool month.
